correctness.rationale: The exact logit conjugacy gives a derivative s_a'(y)=1-(a/4)sech^2(y/2). For 0<a≤8, integrating its derivative proves strict distance diminution for distinct states despite the endpoint derivative -1 at one isolated point. Tail drift and IVT establish a return-map fixed point for every periodic target, strict separation proves uniqueness and global attraction; bounded-input inward drift gives compactness for arbitrary forcing, whence same-input synchronization and all-a Cesàro calibration. Return multiplier has modulus one at a=8 only if every phase has y=0, forcing b≡1/2. The odd critical map y−4tanh(y/2)=−y+y^3/6−y^5/60+O(y^7) gives the sharp sqrt(n) constant by reciprocal-square increments; preimages of zero are explicitly excepted. For a>8 the centered fixed point is repelling. The included checker was run on its actual candidate path and verifies exact algebra plus bounded diagnostic samples; finite tests are not substituted for the quantified proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: A general nonautonomous contraction theorem with a uniform strict contraction constant would give periodic attraction if its hypotheses held, but the logit maps have derivative approaching 1 at infinity and attain -1 at the endpoint. The bespoke inward-drift + strict distance decrease proof gives endpoint global attraction, exact critical forcing rigidity, and power-law constant. Related adaptive learning-rate and time-varying-game results do not imply this prescribed-target classification. Possible uninspected abstract nonautonomous results remain a historical priority risk.

value.rationale: Whether changing an equilibrium target can destroy pointwise convergence despite each frozen game being stable is a natural stability issue for discrete learning. The sharp universal a≤8 theorem covers all periodic schedules, including a nonuniform strict-contraction endpoint, and distinguishes precisely when critical inverse-square-root relaxation survives nonconstant forcing. It additionally separates dynamical synchronization (which fails above 8 for some inputs) from input-average calibration (valid at every a under bounded inputs). These are structural threshold and rigidity statements for a motivated model, not arbitrary parameter census; the autonomous special case is not counted as novel value.
